reasoning_content:
Let me use the tarball since we're running in a WSL2 container. Actually, ddev inside a container — ddev expects to run on the host with Docker access. We have docker CLI + daemon. Let's install ddev from tarball and put in PATH.

The tarball likely contains ddev, ddev-hostname, mkcert. Let me download and extract.

action.command: cd /tmp && curl -fsSL -o ddev.tar.gz https://github.com/ddev/ddev/releases/download/v1.25.4/ddev_linux-amd64.v1.25.4.tar.gz && tar tzf ddev.tar.gz && tar xzf ddev.tar.gz -C /usr/local/bin --strip-components=0 2>&1; echo "exit $?"; ls -la /usr/local/bin | grep ddev
